name: heliolune
description: Native V2 persistent Luna ownership with zero-model terminal I/O and independent Sol acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent Luna ownership with bounded I/O.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune 0.8 alpha.4 keeps and reuses one Luna/max engineering owner for bounded implementation and repair turns, uses zero-model HelioTerm I/O by default, validates structured evidence, and requires independent Sol diff and acceptance checks.
defaultPrompt: Use $heliolune for one validated task with a reusable Luna owner.
Use $heliolune R2 only when a reusable Luna terminal fallback is explicitly needed.
